title: 第3章 功法瞬间领悟第4章 逆天悟性
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
沧浪山脉群峦叠嶂，共有三十六峰。
沈家占据了七大峰，藏经阁位于最北方的天微峰。
天微峰高耸入云，半山腰被人为开辟出巨大平台，放眼望去，一座三层阁楼伫立在平台中心。
藏经楼通体由灵木打造，榫桙结构，红漆玉瓦，外墙雕刻着各类仙鹤瑞兽，古色古香。
沈云步入其中，一楼只有零星几人，显得格外空旷。
整齐的木架上摆放着各类玉简，大概有近千枚，每个玉简旁边配有书籍，用来介绍其中内容。
如果想要换取功法，守阁人就会打开禁制，之后扣除相应的贡献点。
此时有位白发老者慢步走来，书架前的青年恭敬道：“我要换取这门水元功，麻烦明老了。”
沈明信手一挥，玉简光芒闪烁，旋即开口道：“一个时辰八十贡献点，好了再喊我。”
沈云看着这一幕，心中有点奇怪，下意识的抬头看向前方。
藏经阁门口有位身穿宽松白袍的年轻人，在躺椅上晒太阳，边看书边喝茶，好不快意。
“年轻人躺平，老年人辛苦工作，真是倒反天罡。”
沈云轻声自语，随后将这些事抛在脑后，朝着沈卿若说道：“你应该已经选好功法了吧，不用等我了。”
沈卿若摇了摇头，轻声道：“没关系，我正好也要找一门身法。”
沈云点了点头，旋即开始挑选功法，没发现躺椅上的年轻人看了他一眼，嘴里念念有词，“我工作的时候他还没出生呢。”
打了个哈欠，青年闭眼开始小憩，明老走来点上檀香，换上茶水，尽显自然。
沈云绕了一圈，发现一层全是炼气境的功法，修炼法占了五分之一，大多是战斗类法术，还有一些旁门左道之法。
“我是金火木三灵根，还是先选一门金系功法吧。”
沈云挑选了一本《金锋诀》，金系灵力攻击最为强悍，对飞剑、飞刀这类法器加持极大，一般都被作为首选。
过了一柱香的功夫，沈云已将所有内容牢记于心，旋即有了种奇妙的感受。

“修炼法这么简单的吗？我好像已经入门了。”
沈云觉得这可能是个错觉，于是开始回忆《金锋诀》的每条段落，然而他的感觉更加强烈了，似乎只要运转功法，立刻就能引气入体，成就炼气境。
这些内容在他眼里就像一加一这么简单，根本感受不到半点难度，于是他换了本《烈火功》，结果没有任何区别。
沈云心中一动，继续阅读《青木功》，等三次免费机会用完，当即生出回去试验的念头。
于是他和沈卿若打了个招呼，马不停蹄的向家中赶去。
明老有些奇怪的看了他一眼，喃喃道：“一刻钟就把三次机会用完了，真是个奇怪的家伙。”
躺椅上的青年伸了个懒腰，随口道：“这小子的＇神＇非常强大，领悟几门炼气功法并不难。”
明老心头一讶，能让这位方先生认同的人，得追溯到四五十年前了。
青年坐起了身子，看向亭亭玉立的沈卿若，心中暗想道：那个小子比起小丫头还是差了点，一天时间就炼气入体，沈家倒是出了个好苗子。
沈云家位于落云峰，此地山清水秀、风景壮阔，水路之下有一条灵脉，整座山峰被灵气环绕，仙意盎然，仿佛丹青水墨。
沈父沈平生是一个三灵根修士，四十岁突破炼气七层，从此成为旁系的一名执事，这才在落云峰安家。
山腰处有一片竹林，林中有一座两层的木质阁楼，简约而不失淡雅。
沈平生经常把“宁可食无肉，不可居无竹”
挂在嘴边，这片竹林是他来时亲手种下，如今已亭亭如盖。
沈云拿出了一枚玉符，顿时竹林刮起了微风，竹叶簌簌作响，随后阁楼的大门缓缓敞开。
此阵法是沈平生亲手布置，他经常吹嘘自己布阵的英姿吸引了沈母，这才在众多竞争者中脱颖而出。
沈云对此表示怀疑，不过沈平生的阵法手艺确实不错，起码让他俩衣食无忧。
content_en:
The Canglang Mountains are a group of mountains with a total of thirty-six peaks.
The Shen family occupies the seven peaks, and the Sutra Collection Pavilion is located at the northernmost Tianwei Peak.
Tianwei Peak towers into the clouds, and a huge platform has been carved out halfway up the mountain. Looking around, a three-story attic stands in the center of the platform.
The whole body of the Buddhist scripture building is made of spiritual wood, with a mortise and tenon structure, red lacquered jade tiles, and various kinds of cranes and auspicious animals carved on the outer wall, which is antique.
Shen Yun walked inside. There were only a few people on the first floor, which made it look particularly empty.
There are nearly a thousand jade slips of various types placed on neat wooden shelves. Each jade slip is accompanied by a book to introduce its contents.
If you want to exchange for skills, the guardian will open the ban and then deduct the corresponding contribution points.
At this time, a white-haired old man walked slowly. The young man in front of the bookshelf said respectfully: "I want to exchange for this Shui Yuan Gong. I'm sorry to bother Ming Lao."
Shen Mingxin waved his hand, and the jade slip flashed with light, and he immediately said: "Eighty contribution points in one hour, call me when you're done."
Chen Yun looked at this scene, feeling a little strange in his heart, and subconsciously raised his head and looked forward.
At the entrance of the Sutra Pavilion, there was a young man in a loose white robe, sunbathing on a lounge chair, reading a book and drinking tea, feeling very happy.
"Young people lie down while old people work hard. It's really contrary to Tiangang."
Shen Yun whispered to himself, then put these things behind him and said to Shen Qingruo: "You should have already chosen the technique. You don't have to wait for me."
Shen Qingruo shook her head and said softly: "It doesn't matter, I just want to find a movement technique."
Chen Yun nodded and immediately began to choose the exercises. Unexpectedly, the young man on the recliner glanced at him and muttered, "He was not born when I was working."
Yawning, the young man closed his eyes and began to take a nap. Ming Lao came over and lit some sandalwood and replaced it with tea, showing his natural appearance.
Chen Yun walked around and found that the first floor was full of Qi-refining realm exercises, with cultivation methods accounting for one-fifth. Most of them were combat spells, as well as some heretical methods.
"I have the three spiritual roots of metal, fire, and wood, so I'd better choose a metal-based technique first."
Shen Yun picked out a book called "Golden Edge Technique". The metal-type spiritual power attack is the most powerful, and it is a great blessing for magic weapons such as flying swords and flying knives. It is generally regarded as the first choice.
After a stick of incense, Chen Yun had memorized all the contents in his mind, and immediately had a strange feeling.
"Is the cultivation method so simple? I seem to have already started."
Shen Yun felt that this might be an illusion, so he began to recall every paragraph of "Jin Feng Jue". However, his feeling became stronger. It seemed that as long as he ran the technique, he could immediately draw Qi into the body and achieve the Qi refining state.
In his eyes, these contents were as simple as one plus one, and he couldn't feel the slightest difficulty at all, so he changed the book "Fire Fire Technique", but there was no difference in the result.
Chen Yun's heart moved and he continued reading "Aoki Kung". After the three free opportunities were used up, he immediately had the idea to go back and experiment.
So he said hello to Shen Qingruo and rushed home without stopping.
Ming Lao gave him a strange look and murmured: "He used up three opportunities in a quarter of an hour. What a strange guy."
The young man on the recliner stretched and said casually: "This boy's 'spirit' is very powerful. It is not difficult to master a few qi-refining techniques."
Mr. Ming was surprised. The person who could be recognized by Mr. Fang had to go back forty or fifty years ago.
The young man sat up, looked at the slim Shen Qingruo, and thought to himself: That boy is still a little worse than the little girl. He refined his Qi into his body in one day, and the Shen family has a good child.
Shen Yun's family is located in Luoyun Peak, a place with beautiful mountains and clear waters and magnificent scenery. There is a spiritual vein under the waterway. The entire mountain peak is surrounded by spiritual energy, full of fairyland, like a painting and ink painting.
Shen's father, Shen Pingsheng, was a monk with three spiritual roots. He broke through to the seventh level of Qi Refining at the age of forty and became a deacon of the collateral branch. Only then did he settle down in Luoyun Peak.
There is a mountainsideIn a bamboo forest, there is a two-story wooden loft, which is simple yet elegant.
Shen Pingsheng often said, "It is better to eat without meat than live without bamboo."
He kept saying that this bamboo forest was planted by himself when he came here, and now it is like a canopy.
Chen Yun took out a jade talisman, and suddenly a breeze blew in the bamboo forest, the bamboo leaves rustled, and then the door to the attic slowly opened.
This formation was arranged by Shen Pingsheng himself. He often boasted that his heroic appearance in the formation attracted Shen's mother, and this made him stand out among many competitors.
Shen Yun expressed doubts about this, but Shen Pingsheng's formation skills were indeed good, which at least allowed them to have enough food and clothing.
